newsitem.title: USA: Pier 1 July same-store sales rose 17.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pier 1 July same-store sales rose 17.9 pct.

text.p: Pier 1 Imports Inc Thursday said sales for the four week period ended Aug. 2, 1997, totalled $81,337,000, up 12.7 percent from the year ago's $72,202,000, with comparable store sales up 17.9 percent for the period.
Year-to-date sales of $405,116,000 were up 11.0 percent from $364,894,000 last year and same store sales grew 14.9 percent.
"July's sales exceeded the company's expectations as we continue to average double digit sales gains for 22 months," said Clark A. Johnson, chairman and chief executive.
"Strong July transactions have historically translated into positive Christmas traffic and sales, and management expects the company to maintain its positive momentum throughout the fiscal year."

Pier 1 Imports is North America's largest specialty retailer of imported decorative home furnishings, gifts and related items with 732 stores in 47 states, Puerto Rico, Canada, the United Kingdom, Japan and Mexico.
